additional_info.subject: RE: ID0397214-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/RN 313405951029] Power converter error CRM:01811000537
additional_info.body:
Hello Mert,
I hope you're doing well.
Upon reviewing the logs, we found that the command
OCPP: Received command: ChangeConfiguration "key":"PowerSavingModeSchedule.
was executed, which has caused the charger to enter Power Saving Mode.
When this mode is activated and no charging processes are active, the main switch (QA1) opens after 3 minutes, disconnecting the power line (including the converters) from the mains. This is the reason behind the converter error you've been experiencing.
To resolve this issue, please send disable the Power-Saving Mode. This will prevent the power line disconnection and eliminate the error.
Thank you for your attention to this matter. We look forward to your response.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
